chosen-mark.$description: A check mark for a chosen tile. With the fill, it means color is never the only sign a tile is chosen.

chosen-frost.$description: A chosen Glass tile turns milky: this frost over a blur of what's behind it. Milky cream frost over the dark page, strong enough to read as chosen while the cream text keeps 4.5:1. The text sits on top, untouched.

title-large.$description: 1: a tile's title uses the theme's title size; 0: its heading size, one step down. Spotlight's heading is the same size as its body text, so its tiles use the title size (Sharon, Oct 14).

ink-soft.$description: The tile's label and description color on its own fill. Fireside uses its warm grey: its secondary text color is a honey yellow that read wrong next to the cream title (Sharon, Oct 14).
